title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters because it ensures users are always accessing the application securely, improving security and trust. It automatically redirects HTTP requests to HTTPS, providing a seamless experience. This feature is essential for production environments
testCases: Test HTTP request redirects to HTTPS
Test HTTPS request is not redirected
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all HTTP requests are automatically redirected to HTTPS, and HTTPS requests are not redirected
reason: Implementing automatic HTTPS redirect is a high-impact feature that improves security and is a common requirement for production-ready applications
